releaseNotes:
Garage virtual-energy and temperature readings remain available through repeated live updates. The run-recorded notification appears once after a confirmed Garage return; recordings and session selection are preserved. Shift-light glow is softer.

Rookline installs and runs independently. RookForce is a separate optional application with its own installation and interface.

The Windows x64 installer is not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies its published SHA-256 and file version through this HTTPS manifest before updater launch.
